ROBI successfully delivered 1 out of 114 orders within an average time of 51 seconds and a median of 53 seconds during the specified period. The slowest order was for a ballpoint pen, taking 53 seconds to deliver. Given this pattern, it might be beneficial to optimize delivery times by focusing on items that are typically quicker to handle, such as common household staples.

Suggestion: Optimize ROBI's handling of frequently ordered items like bread and milk to ensure faster delivery times.
